step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture represents Levels Beyond's 'Media to Cloud' workflow powered by Reach Engine on AWS. Raw media uploaded to Amazon S3 triggers AWS Step Functions, which orchestrates multiple parallel workflows: video proxy generation via AWS Elemental MediaConvert, visual content and metadata tagging via Amazon Rekognition, and speech-to-text processing via Amazon Transcribe. Text output from Transcribe is analyzed for entities by Amazon Comprehend. Extracted metadata and analysis from MediaConvert, Rekognition, and Comprehend are consolidated into Amazon DynamoDB, which serves as a temporary data store before being ingested into Reach Engine running on Amazon EC2/EKS.

nodes.name: Rekognition

nodes.name: Transcribe
nodes.notes: Converts audio from media files into text.

nodes.name: Comprehend
nodes.notes: Extracts entities and analyzes sentiment/profanity from transcribed text.

nodes.name: EKS

edges.notes: File upload to S3 triggers AWS Step Functions workflow.
Step Functions kicks off proxy generation in MediaConvert.
MediaConvert writes proxy metadata to DynamoDB.
Step Functions triggers video analysis in Rekognition.
Rekognition saves visual analysis tags and timestamps into DynamoDB.
Step Functions triggers speech-to-text conversion in Transcribe.
Transcribe passes transcript text to Comprehend for entity analysis.
Comprehend stores extracted text entities and analysis into DynamoDB.
DynamoDB triggers data ingest into Reach Engine on EC2.
